Name: Audio Forge
Description: Control Audio Forge ambiance and music playback from your Stream Deck

com.slashpaf.audioforge.play-pause.Name: Play / Pause
com.slashpaf.audioforge.play-pause.Tooltip: Toggle play/pause for Music or Ambiance

com.slashpaf.audioforge.stop.Name: Stop
com.slashpaf.audioforge.stop.Tooltip: Stop Music, Ambiance, Echoes, or all playback

com.slashpaf.audioforge.next-track.Name: Next Track
com.slashpaf.audioforge.next-track.Tooltip: Skip to the next track in the active Music or Ambiance categories

com.slashpaf.audioforge.category.Name: Category
com.slashpaf.audioforge.category.Tooltip: Play or toggle a specific category

com.slashpaf.audioforge.volume.Name: Volume
com.slashpaf.audioforge.volume.Tooltip: Set or adjust volume for Music or Ambiance
